comparison.objective: Function-test a seat-belt retractor through slow pull, jerk, and rewind, not tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Controls pull velocity and releases webbing to exercise an inertial lock; no fine tool use or parameter adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Steady 150 mm pull, jerk at least 0.30 m/s, lock within 15 mm, rewind within 5 mm, and release versus two tuned carriage stops.
comparison.reason: Both observe a dynamic mechanism, but this record only tests a fixed safety device rather than calibrating and locking one.
